messages.text:
BL-1605 — swarm_handoff.bb synthesizes a non-forwarding reverse copy (back-one/back-all) to every earlier role, including the role the git_handoff is ALREADY addressed to - so an architect bounce to the cleaner arrives twice in one batch, once as the bounce and once as a merge-only twin with the same task and commit, and the batch-aware send gate then refuses the cleaner's re-forward for the whole batch; twice on 2026-09-16 a fixed bounce sat unforwarded for fifty minutes until the coordinator chased; the reverse set drops the forward's own recipients, a bounce to a role arrives once, and the earlier roles' merge-only copies are unchanged
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the reverse set for a git_handoff is the pack-declared earlier roles MINUS the roles the forward already names; a role never receives both a forwarding and a non-forwarding copy of one …
BL-1605 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1605" (or "reject BL-1605 <reason>") to act.
